concept: S3 storage classes: Glacier Deep Archive for long-term archives
tests: Choosing the cheapest storage class for rarely retrieved archives kept for years with retrieval within 12 hours acceptable.
expected: S3 Glacier Deep Archive — lowest storage cost; Standard retrieval within 12 h. Triggers: "retain 7 years", "almost never retrieved", "retrieval within 12 hours".
why_not: Standard and Standard-IA cost far more per GB; Intelligent-Tiering adds a monitoring fee and isn't needed when the access pattern is known.
